parsed.explanation: No known visitor-facing exposure appears: no trans-specific offence, no documented police targeting, border/document/facility/custody practice entirely unsourced, and no universal-exposure measure. The sodomy statute (ss.153-155) is unenforced with zero recorded prosecutions and, per rule 2, is tangential absent evidence of use against gender-nonconforming people; the documented traditional gender-diverse role is a direct social-acceptance signal (rule 13). Structural extrapolation from thin data therefore points neutral-to-positive: functioning institutions (UPR participation, employment SOGI protection) with no hostile layer. Deductions: the social-climate finding is 2015-dated and cannot be treated as current, there is no demonstrated service remedy, no general non-discrimination coverage, and open questions on documents, custody, and care. That combination — acceptance signal plus latent statute plus open questions and thin recourse — sits a step below acceptance-with-protections, but well above tiers with documented exposures.
